correctness.rationale: The differentiated identity d[r²(J_j²+J_{j+1}²)²]/dr=2r(2j+1)(J_j⁴−J_{j+1}⁴) follows algebraically from standard Bessel recurrences. All boundary cases, positivity, renormalized fixed-order asymptotics, and the uniform q↓4 mean-zero phase subtraction are proved in RESULT.md. The fixed-q pole residue 3/π² and the 1/(π√3) coefficient follow via a mean-value expansion. Independent symbolic and finite numerical calculations are supplemental.
